p: Defines the interface for rendering graphics to a canvas. Provides methods for initializing, resizing, and rendering content onto the canvas surface.
Initializes the canvas with the specified width and height.

ul.li: width (int): The width of the canvas in pixels. Must be greater than zero.
height (int): The height of the canvas in pixels. Must be greater than zero.

p: Resizes the canvas to the specified width and height.

ul.li: width (int): The new width of the canvas. Must be greater than zero.
height (int): The new height of the canvas. Must be greater than zero.

p: Renders the graphical content to the canvas using the provided draw action.

ul.li: draw (Action): The action that defines the drawing logic on the canvas.
